reference_basis.instruction: Preserve geometry and colouring, not clothing, pose, room, or wide-angle selfie perspective.

face_geometry.description: Short rounded-oval face with broad full cheeks, a soft lower face, rounded jaw corners, and a compact softly rounded chin; never angular or V-shaped.

eyes.description: Bright green-hazel rounded-almond eyes of medium-large size, average spacing, visible lid fold, and gently lifted outer corners; green iris with warm hazel near the pupil.

brows.description: Warm auburn-brown brows, medium-full, softly straight through the inner section with a mild natural arch.

nose.description: Medium-width nose with a smooth short-to-medium bridge, softly rounded slightly lifted tip, and natural nostril width.

mouth.description: Medium-wide mouth with plush natural lips, soft cupid's bow, and a fuller lower lip; smile is cheek-led and friendly.

skin.description: Fair-to-light warm skin with natural peach flush. Dense copper-brown freckles bridge the nose and upper cheeks, with lighter freckling across forehead, shoulders, arms, and torso.

hair.description: Natural copper-auburn hair, thick, shoulder to upper-chest length, with loose irregular wave and abundant movement. Base colour remains unmistakable under varied lighting.

body_proportions.description: Compact athletic-curvy frame with developed but soft shoulders and arms, defined waist, full hips, and strong substantial thighs; active and powerful without bodybuilder definition.

identity_relationships.facial_length_to_width: short-to-moderate length with strong cheek width
identity_relationships.cheek_to_jaw_transition: full cheeks descend into a soft rounded jaw with minimal angular break
identity_relationships.nose_to_mouth_relationship: medium nose and moderately broad mouth remain balanced
identity_relationships.lip_ratio: upper lip full; lower lip modestly fuller
identity_relationships.feature_balance: freckles, copper hair, bright eyes, and full cheeks form the dominant identity cluster

expression_behavior.neutral: Open energetic face with softly raised mouth corners and alert eyes.
expression_behavior.smile: Broad friendly smile pushes full cheeks upward and gently rounds the lower eyelids.
expression_behavior.cheek_response: Cheeks become distinctly rounder and create shallow smile folds.
expression_behavior.eye_response: Outer corners lift slightly and eyes narrow without losing their bright open quality.

signature_features.feature: dense freckles over a warm flushed complexion
short rounded face with full cheeks

negative_identity_constraints: do not converge toward Charlotte's heart-shaped narrow-chin geometry
